raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since batch 13, rows from the new 'v2' collector have txn_ts exactly 6 hours ahead of legacy rows. Interleaved txn_ids show this: v2 12:12:04 sits between legacy 06:10:32 and 06:12:43, and v2 12:03/12:04 sits just before legacy 06:04:26. This looks like UTC versus local time (UTC-6), which pushes evening transactions into 00:00-06:00 and onto the next day (2026-01-19). The fix shifts v2 timestamps back 6 hours in silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
